critical_code_review_comments: booking_extensions.py uses `from server import db` (line 27) and `from routes.booking_intelligence import check_booking_access` (line 28) — works but creates a circular-ish dependency on server module. Acceptable for now.

_can_write() at line 39 checks `roles.get('mgt') or roles.get('operations') or roles.get('ops')` — verified via test that franchise_owner (which has no 'mgt'/'operations' role) correctly receives 403 on all 4 write endpoints (menu/upsert, tiffin/catering/event create).
PDF generation imports reportlab inside the route functions (lazy import) — good pattern, avoids startup penalty.

TiffinCreate (line 55) accepts free-form subtotal/gst/total without validation — matches user requirement explicitly: 'do not validate that total = subtotal + gst for tiffin'. Verified test creates booking with total=1234 while subtotal=1000+gst=50 and value persists unchanged.

Catering/Event Pydantic models do NOT enforce inclusive GST carve at backend — relies on frontend to send pre-computed gst. Acceptable since canonical formula is documented as single-source-of-truth in /app/frontend/src/pages/CateringOrders.jsx and /app/frontend/src/pages/EventBookings.jsx (recompute()). Backend faithfully persists what frontend sends.
/api/bookings/create does not include `table_allotted` in the persisted booking dict — see action items. Update endpoint at line 488-516 correctly handles it.
